Tahoma Terrier Trial VII
DIVISION A: Racing
No Post Entries In Racing. Begins promptly at 8:00 AM. Height Calls must be made by 7:15 AM and measurements completed by 7:45 AM ALL terriers must be muzzled to race with either a plastic basket or close-ended cloth muzzle. No figure-8 or open-ended  muzzles allowed. No colored muzzles. No Baskerville muzzles.   To be eligible for the Championship, terriers must have entered and finished both flats & hurdles. A Finished race is when the terrier runs down the track unassisted (by owner or anyone else) with a secured muzzle to the backside of the barrier. Any terrier racing without a secure muzzle will be disqualified. No refund will be given. Adult terriers MAY NOT CROSS ENTER between Adult, Veteran, and Senior Racing classes. SEE POSTED RACING RULES! Championship classes have no entry fee. You MUST have your dog ON DECK and securely muzzled in order to race. If you need help, please ask for it in advance. DO NOT wait until it’s time to load into the starting boxes. BE PREPARED. Racing classes will be run in the precise sequence posted in this trial premium, except at the discretion of the racing judge, to accommodate re-runs and multiple heats, for the safety of our terriers.

DIVISION E: Super Earth Go-to-Ground
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to any Jack Russell Terrier, 6 months and older. 30 seconds per 30 feet of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

Tahoma Terrier Trial VIII
DIVISION A: Racing
No Post Entries In Racing. Begins promptly at 8:00 AM. Height Calls must be made by 7:15 AM and measurements completed by 7:45 AM ALL terriers must be muzzled to race with either a plastic basket or close-ended cloth muzzle. No figure-8 or open-ended  muzzles allowed. No colored muzzles. No Baskerville muzzles.   To be eligible for the Championship, terriers must have entered and finished both flats & hurdles. A Finished race is when the terrier runs down the track unassisted (by owner or anyone else) with a secured muzzle to the backside of the barrier. Any terrier racing without a secure muzzle will be disqualified. No refund will be given. Adult terriers MAY NOT CROSS ENTER between Adult, Veteran, and Senior Racing classes. SEE POSTED RACING RULES! Championship classes have no entry fee. You MUST have your dog ON DECK and securely muzzled in order to race. If you need help, please ask for it in advance. DO NOT wait until it’s time to load into the starting boxes. BE PREPARED. Racing classes will be run in the precise sequence posted in this trial premium, except at the discretion of the racing judge, to accommodate re-runs and multiple heats, for the safety of our terriers.

DIVISION E: Super Earth Go-to-Ground
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to any Jack Russell Terrier, 6 months and older. 30 seconds per 30 feet of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

DIVISION G: NON-SANCTIONED FUN EVENTS
Youth will have TWO free runs unless otherwise noted.
Section 1: Lure Coursing (Non-Sanctioned)
This is a timed event in which the terrier chases a lure in an enclosed fenced course. Each dog will be running individually and will get two runs. No experience necessary. Enter as many times as you like. Class fee for 2 qualifying runs for a 1-6 ribbon placement; sign up on entry form or at the Registration Desk. Fun runs available directly from the judge, 2 for $5  Youth fun runs must be AFTER official class.
